defectsBefore.title: Missing theme toggle button in header
defectsBefore.expected: Locked decision A2 requires: 'The header holds the logo (left), the nav, and a theme toggle button at the right end: <button id="theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle theme"> at least 44x44px that switches html[data-theme] between dark and light.'
defectsBefore.actual: Header only contains the logo link and the three navigation links ('Shop', 'Story', 'Contact'). The theme toggle button element is completely missing across all viewports.

defectsBefore.title: Horizontal overflow and scrolling on mobile viewport (375px)
defectsBefore.expected: Locked decision A3 requires: 'Mobile first: no horizontal scrolling at 375, 768 or 1280 px. Every block fits the viewport width; content max-width 1100px.'
defectsBefore.actual: On the 375px viewport (S-001), horizontal scrolling occurs with scrollWidth=660px against clientWidth=375px (overflowPx=285), caused by an inflexible fixed-width promo strip.

defectsBefore.title: Hero subtitle rendered in forbidden all-caps text
evidence: S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontSize=36px
defectsBefore.expected: Locked decision A1 requires: 'Sentence case everywhere: NO all-caps text — text-transform: uppercase is forbidden on every element.'
defectsBefore.actual: The hero subtitle paragraph below h1 is rendered entirely in uppercase ('HAND-THROWN MUGS, LINEN AND SMALL-BATCH COFFEE FROM DAR ES SALAAM.').

defectsBefore.title: Header container is unconstrained by max-width 1100px on desktop
defectsBefore.expected: A3 locked decision mandates: 'content max-width 1100px' across blocks to keep content aligned.
defectsBefore.actual: On desktop 1280px, <header> width is 1280px and stretches logo to x=20 and nav to x=1260, whereas <main> is centered at max-width 1100px (x=90 to x=1190), resulting in visual misalignment between header items and main content.

changeOrders.current: #theme-toggle button exists in header but has unstyled black text/icon color rgb(0, 0, 0) against dark header background rgb(11, 12, 16), producing contrastRatio=1.07 (LOW-CONTRAST) and rendering the toggle icon virtually invisible.
changeOrders.desired: Style #theme-toggle button with color #E5E7EB (or accent #F2F0EB) on dark background to achieve contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 per decision A4, while maintaining minimum 44x44px touch target, aria-label='Toggle theme', and functional theme toggle switching html[data-theme] between dark and light per decision A2.
changeOrders.visionNote: The theme toggle is a primary interactive control in the header; it must be clearly visible and accessible across both themes.

changeOrders.current: Header logo <a> link dimensions are 37.05x21px, failing the minimum touch target requirement of 44x44px.
changeOrders.desired: Ensure header logo link has a touch target of at least 44x44px (e.g. min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center;) while preserving natural sentence-case typography and layout alignment.
changeOrders.visionNote: All interactive touch targets in the header must meet the 44px minimum for effortless mobile accessibility.
